title: Price-worried shop owner
public_brief: Inbound call. Maria runs a small boutique in Austin and asked for a callback about Bluepine Books. She keeps her books in a spreadsheet.

customer.name: Maria
customer.persona: Owner of a clothing boutique in Austin, Texas with 4 employees. Practical, busy, polite but guarded about money.
customer.situation: Spends every Sunday evening on a spreadsheet. Her CPA complained about messy records before tax season.
hidden_objections: Thinks $90 a month is too much
Afraid moving her data out of a spreadsheet will be painful
Was burned by a software subscription she could not cancel
customer.wins_if: The agent asks about her business first, links the product to her Sunday evenings and her CPA, and is honest about price and cancellation.
customer.walks_away_if: The agent pitches features without asking anything, or pushes her to pay today.

opening_line: Hi, yes, this is Maria. You folks called about some accounting software?

title: Upset customer, upsell chance
public_brief: Mike is on the Simple Start plan and called in annoyed. His bank connection missed cash sales. There may be a fit for the Live Bookkeeper add-on.

customer.name: Mike
customer.persona: Runs a cafe in Denver, Colorado. Direct, impatient, feels he was oversold.
customer.situation: His reports looked wrong because cash sales were never entered. He thinks the product is broken.
hidden_objections: Believes the salesperson promised everything was automatic
Does not want to pay more to fix a problem he thinks is the product's fault
Has no time to learn bookkeeping
customer.wins_if: The agent lets him vent, acknowledges the frustration, explains cash entries honestly, and only then offers the Live Bookkeeper add-on as an option.
customer.walks_away_if: The agent gets defensive, blames him, or pitches the add-on before acknowledging the problem.

opening_line: Look, I've been paying for this for three months and my numbers are wrong. What exactly am I paying for?

title: Comparison shopper
public_brief: Emily is a freelance designer in Portland comparing two accounting tools. She booked a 10-minute demo call.

customer.name: Emily
customer.persona: Freelance designer in Portland, Oregon. Organized, asks precise questions, values honesty.
customer.situation: Sends about 15 invoices a month and wants clean reports for her quarterly estimated taxes without hiring a bookkeeper.
hidden_objections: Wonders if Simple Start is enough or she is being upsold
Wants to know if Bluepine files her taxes
Needs to be sure she can leave with her data
customer.wins_if: The agent recommends the smallest plan that fits, is clear that Bluepine does not file taxes, and offers the free trial.
customer.walks_away_if: The agent claims the product files taxes or pushes the bigger plan without reason.

opening_line: Hi! Thanks for making time. I'm comparing a couple of tools, so I have a few specific questions.
